title: Power Display not detecting additional monitors
author: Seguaro

status.label: Waiting on author confirmation
status.detail: Maintainer asked affected users to test 0.101 max compatibility mode; one commenter confirmed success, but the broader open report still awaits current confirmation.

next_action.label: Wait for author feedback
next_action.reason: No new maintainer action; keep waiting for affected users to confirm whether 0.101 max compatibility mode resolves their monitor detection.

judgment.rationale: This is not a 0.101 release regression. The issue predates 0.101, and the latest maintainer request is for users to upgrade to 0.101 and try max compatibility mode.
evidence: Original report was filed against PowerToys 0.99.0 with Power Display missing additional monitors.
Labels include Needs-Author-Feedback and Product-PowerDisplay; assignee is moooyo.
Maintainer asked users to upgrade to 0.101 and enable max cap mode.
One affected commenter replied "Works" after trying the 0.101/max-cap guidance.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for remaining/original author confirmation; do not ask for evidence again yet.

issue_context.summary: Power Display failed to list or control all monitors for several users on pre-0.101 builds; maintainers asked affected users to retest with the 0.101 max compatibility mode.
known_information: Issue body and comments include multiple monitor setups, DDC/CI capability output, screenshots, and several bug report ZIPs.
The issue is marked Needs-Author-Feedback and assigned to moooyo.
Latest maintainer instruction was to upgrade to 0.101 and try max cap mode.
A commenter confirmed the guidance works.
inferences: 0.101 is currently a possible fix/workaround version, not evidence of a regression.
Because not every affected user has confirmed, maintainers may keep the issue open for author feedback.
issue_context.analysis: The existing evidence is sufficient to avoid a new request-info action: the open question is simply whether affected users still reproduce after the maintainer-specified 0.101 mode.
initial_investigation: Search for max cap mode found additional PowerDisplay monitor-detection reports, but no newer fixing PR that supersedes the maintainer request.
